cohort: Pregnant women with morbidly adherent placenta at a tertiary care referral hospital in Mumbai, India
finding: The study found an incidence of morbidly adherent placenta of 1.32 per 1000 pregnancies, with most patients having previous caesarean sections and placenta praevia, and highlighted the effectiveness of prophylactic interventions like uterine artery embolization in preserving the uterus and reducing blood loss.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was the mode of delivery in 90% of patients.
